Latest: Complete Tax Solution: Latest Tax News India, Tax Notification

Core Message

Regulatory bodies like SEBI and RBI are proposing new frameworks and amending governance rules, while courts continue to clarify GST compliance for businesses and provide relief for certain corporate defaults.

Key Takeaways

  • SEBI has proposed new frameworks for strike prices of options contracts and IPO/re-listed scrip price discovery to address market integrity concerns.
  • Courts have reiterated that bona fide purchasers are generally not liable to lose Input Tax Credit solely due to suppliers' non-deposit of GST, and transit states cannot penalize pure inter-state transit without actual tax evasion.
  • The MCA's Companies Compliance Facilitation Scheme (CCFS-2026) offers a relief window by reducing additional filing fees for defaulting companies.
  • RBI has amended governance directions for Rural and Urban Co-operative Banks to prevent directors from circumventing tenure limits.
  • A CA certificate format clarifies that dealing and investment in securities are outside the scope of GST, exempting companies solely engaged in such activities from GST registration.

Action Items / Alerts

FSSAI revised contaminant limits in pulses, oils, and seafood will be effective from December 1, 2026. The ICAI's 60-Tax Audit assignment ceiling via the UDIN system will commence from April 1, 2026.

Accounts and Taxation Digest

Monday, 25 May 2026 | Morning Intelligence Tracker

Website

Taxguru

https://taxguru.in

Latest: Complete Tax Solution: Latest Tax News India, Tax Notification

Core Message

Recent regulatory updates and judicial rulings across GST, Income Tax, Corporate Law, SEBI, and international trade emphasize compliance and strategic financial planning in India.

Key Takeaways

  • State GST authorities in transit states cannot impose penalties under Section 129 for pure inter-state transit, and companies dealing solely in securities may not require GST registration.
  • MCA's Companies Compliance Facilitation Scheme (CCFS-2026) provides relief by reducing additional filing fees for defaulting companies, while the IBC (Amendment) Act, 2026 introduces significant insolvency reforms.
  • ITAT rulings have clarified aspects of Income Tax, including Section 54 exemptions for jointly owned properties and delays in project completion, and specifics for Section 270A penalty recalculation.
  • SEBI proposes reforms for IPO and re-listed scrip price discovery to prevent artificial suppression, and the ICAI has confirmed a 60-tax audit assignment ceiling through the UDIN system from April 2026.
  • The current environment of rising inflation and global war uncertainty underscores the critical importance of robust financial planning.

Action Items / Alerts

Nainital Bank Limited has invited CA firms for Statutory Central Auditor Empanelment for FY 2026-27. Companies with pending MCA filings should review the CCFS-2026 for potential relief on additional fees. Finance professionals should monitor SEBI's proposed IPO rules and adjust financial planning strategies in light of economic uncertainties.

YouTube

FinTaxPro

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ooGGta2NYV8

Latest: India Banking Limits 2026 | Cash, UPI, NEFT, RTGS, IMPS Rules

Core Message

This content outlines key Indian banking transaction limits, tax compliance rules, and penalties for FY 2026-27 to help avoid Income Tax notices.

Key Takeaways

  • Unexplained bank balances can attract up to 84% tax plus penalty, and underreporting income incurs a 200% penalty.
  • New TDS rules may apply tax on the entire amount, not just the excess, particularly under Section 194N for cash withdrawals.
  • Key reporting thresholds include a ₹10 Lakh limit for cash deposits in savings accounts and for Fixed Deposit SFT reporting.
  • EPFO 3.0 updates allow UPI withdrawals up to 75% of EPF balance, introduce EPF-linked ATM cards, and increase the auto-settlement limit to ₹5 Lakh without employer approval (via Aadhaar OTP).

Action Items / Alerts

Ensure strict compliance with all bank transaction limits and SFT reporting thresholds for FY 2026-27 to mitigate significant tax penalties. Familiarize yourself with updated EPFO 3.0 withdrawal procedures and the implications of Sections 194N and 270A to avoid potential tax notices.

Latest: Complete Tax Solution: Latest Tax News India, Tax Notification

Core Message

The Income-tax Act, 2025 has officially replaced the Income-tax Act, 1961 from April 1, 2026, ushering in simplified tax legislation alongside various regulatory updates from SEBI, PFRDA, and GST clarifications.

Key Takeaways

  • The Income-tax Act, 2025 is now effective from April 1, 2026, replacing the 1961 Act with a focus on simplification.
  • SEBI has proposed new IPO and re-listed scrip price discovery rules to prevent artificial suppression and clarified that renewable energy projects via competitive bidding qualify as PPP projects.
  • PFRDA aims to improve subscriber protection by proposing faster grievance resolution timelines under the NPS framework.
  • GST penalties generally require a tax liability, contravention, or deliberate evasion intent, and dealing in securities is outside the scope of GST, thus not requiring registration.
  • ICAI clarified the 60-Tax Audit assignment ceiling, effective through the UDIN system from April 1, 2026.
  • Judicial rulings confirmed capital gains indexation from the actual use date, not occupancy certificate, and stated that Section 271D penalties cannot stand if reassessment is quashed.

Action Items / Alerts

Monitor May 2026 Income Tax and GST compliance deadlines; CA firms may consider Nainital Bank's invitation for Statutory Central Auditor Empanelment for FY 2026-27; note the extension of existing anti-dumping duties until November 2026 and new duties imposed on Monoisopropylamine imports from China.
